findings.detail: Guard verifies supplied current original candle fact/header, requested seed+12baseline row windows, clocks/row refs/comparison basis and equality of retained aggregates. RECONFIRMED_SUPPLIED_CLOSED_ROWS is truthful for that meaning. No new false positive identified within that predicate by static review. It does not recover the first seed acquisition fact_id/evidence or original per-window hashes, and cannot prove original baseline vector equality when different vectors share median/range. Source auth remains false; forged metadata or revision authenticity is outside this proof.

A genuinely new analysis with synchronously matching new fact_id/evidence/header/coverage and source clocks<=its T0 may reconfirm full supplied historical windows. This synchronized rolling-ID positive was not executed in BZ62; expected behavior follows conditions only. Substituting a newer fact into an old immutable analysis leaves old fact_ids/evidence or source clock>T0 and returns UNKNOWN; changing old analysis to fix this is prohibited.

Complete data elsewhere remains UNKNOWN unless supplied as the exact analysis/input candle fact. Different profile, SHORT_HISTORY, absent old metadata/row refs, duplicate declared candle fact_id, >1440 rows, missing required unit flags, or absent current5m declared range can remain UNKNOWN even if humans could independently prove values. Current/seed numerator alone can be verifiable yet all seed features are UNKNOWN when12-window baseline is missing, because one guard couples all8. No external resolver or automatic fallback exists.

Proposal keeps v2 schema/key pump:feature-capsule:v2:<analysis_sha>. Same original generates changed feature payload/digest. Retained original() regenerates on remember and record(); immutable() rejects changed bytes at existing v2 key. A later outcome of an old signal can therefore hit IMMUTABLE_RETAINED_CAPSULE_CONFLICT even if initial new writer was intended only for new signals. BZ62 used a fresh fixture writer without store/old existing capsule, so this collision was not exercised.

integration_plan.action: Introduce a distinct new feature schema and key namespace (recommended v3), plus binding-policy marker outside origin. Keep v2 immutable bytes/keys unchanged. Source status must mean supplied-row reconfirmation, never first-source authentication.

Choose capsule codec deterministically from immutable original metadata/recorded writer epoch and existing feature reference. Pin selection at creation of NEW originals; never choose current code or Date.now at later outcome. Preserve saved original implementation pin. Legacy originals without v3 marker stay legacy; do not mutate/re-hash old analysis/input or backfill originals.

Split raw audit reading from verified seed-feature view. v2 stays readable for audit/labels; its seed features become LEGACY_SOURCE_WINDOW_UNVERIFIED/UNKNOWN in the verified view without rewriting stored values. New schema reader requires expected binding policy, status/range/header-clock consistency and supported writer implementation. Generic boundtrue is insufficient.

Make outcome and summary-link codecs explicit per feature_schema: old v2 outcomes/links retain exact keys and origins, new v3 features/outcomes/links use their own namespace and exact feature hash. Keep signal.origin equality and original+4h. Do not regenerate old v2 payload through new writer. If a legacy original has no saved capsule/reference, return explicit capsule-unavailable/legacy status while preserving original per-wave outcome/summary; do not manufacture verified v3 or block/reclassify the numeric outcome.

No bulk migration, source lookup, reader promotion, deletion, protected-reference removal or current1941 publication modification. Only new eligible originals/capsules after explicitly recorded writer policy use v3; all other full/unread data remains explicit UNKNOWN until a separately scoped resolver is designed/admitted.

ROOT owns coherent canonical/version/retained-writer/read-consumer integration and subsequent artifact. Keep accepted BZ62 component proof attached to e329 exact bytes, but do not treat it as version-routing/store integration proof. BZ63 changes no code and runs no new case.
